name: Electronic Components and Circuits
description: Review of electronic components: passive components, active components including components used in industrial environment. Network theory: KCL, KVL, nodal analysis, network theorems, circuit analysis techniques. Electronic circuits: choppers, clampers, analog circuits, precision and instrumentation amplifiers, signal conditioning circuits, industrial electronic circuits. Nonlinear devices and circuits, computing circuits and waveform generators. Analog-digital circuits: A/D and D/A converters, classification and characteristic parameters of DACs and ADCs. Testing criteria. Digital electronics: logic gates, combinational logic design, sequential logic design, counters. Microprocessors and microcontrollers: 8 bit and 16-bit microprocessor, basic structure and programming. Application of microprocessors in instruments. Introduction to micro-controllers and embedded systems.
